name: Whitehead Tower Killing Homotopy Constraint
domain: algebraic topology / homotopy theory / Postnikov systems
constraint: X⟨n⟩ kills π_k for k≤n and preserves π_k for k>n (n-connected)

cvc5.reason: cvc5 QF_LIA enforces n-connectivity constraint and homotopy group killing

simply_connected_cover.description: X⟨1⟩: π_1=0 (killed), π_k preserved for k>1

n_connected_tower.description: X⟨3⟩ is 3-connected: π_k=0 for k≤3, π_k≠0 for k>3

higher_homotopy_preservation.description: X⟨n⟩→X induces surjection on π_k for k>n

n_connected_contradicts_nonzero_below.description: X⟨n⟩ with π_{n-1}≠0 is impossible (n-connectivity constraint)

killing_above_level_contradiction.description: X⟨n⟩ cannot kill π_k for k>n (must preserve higher groups)

non_n_connected_claimed_as_tower.description: Space with all π_k≠0 cannot be X⟨n⟩ for any n

string_structure_via_whitehead_3.meaning: π_3 is trivialized, so string structure exists
string_structure_via_whitehead_3.description: X⟨3⟩ kills π_3, enabling string structures on spacetime

fivebrane_structure_via_whitehead_7.meaning: π_7 is trivialized, so fivebrane structure exists
fivebrane_structure_via_whitehead_7.description: X⟨7⟩ kills π_7, enabling fivebrane structures in M-theory

whitehead_tower_functoriality.description: Whitehead tower construction is functorial: f: X→Y gives X⟨n⟩→Y⟨n⟩
